The 2024 Form 10‑K restates prior-period numbers to treat Solventum as discontinued operations, so the 2023 revenue figure in the 2024 10‑K ($24,610 million) is not directly comparable to the 2023 revenue figure in the 2023 10‑K ($32,681 million), which included the Health Care business. [DOC: mmm_fy2023_10k.txt; mmm_fy2024_notes.txt]

Using only the directly comparable figures from the 2024 Form 10‑K (which presents 2023 on the same discontinued-operations basis as 2024), total revenue was:

- 2023 revenue: $24,610 million [DOC: mmm_fy2024_income_statement.txt]  
- 2024 revenue: $24,575 million [DOC: mmm_fy2024_income_statement.txt]

Absolute change = $24,575m − $24,610m = −$35m, i.e., a small decline. [DOC: mmm_fy2024_income_statement.txt]

Percentage change = −$35m ÷ $24,610m ≈ −0.14%. [DOC: mmm_fy2024_income_statement.txt]

ANSWER: Revenue declined by approximately 0.14% (a decrease of $35 million) from fiscal 2023 to fiscal 2024, based on continuing operations as presented in the 2024 Form 10‑K.
